description: EU-sovereign OpenAI-compatible inference for open-weight text, vision-language, reasoning and embedding models, with zero data retention.
regional_pricing_notes: TensorX publishes one pay-as-you-go developer price per model across its EU-hosted platform; dedicated and shared clusters use custom pricing.
prompt_training_notes: TensorX states that every inference request has zero data retention and that no third-party model provider processes requests; models run on TensorX-managed EU infrastructure.
